name: snackbar
gotchas: `MatSnackBar.open()` dismisses any snack bar already showing before showing the new one — you cannot stack multiple snack bars, so rapid successive calls only ever show the latest.

`duration` in the config only auto-dismisses the snack bar; it does not pause on hover/focus, so a long message the user is still reading can disappear mid-read unless you omit `duration` for that case.
A custom component passed to `openFromComponent()` cannot inject `MAT_SNACK_BAR_DATA` unless `data` was actually supplied in the config — injecting the token without providing data throws at runtime.
